clips.title: The story
paras: Young tauren shamans are directed to Kodo Rock on Red Cloud Mesa, between Camp Narache and Brambleblade Ravine. The stone rises among Mulgore’s grasses, easy to miss against the rolling land.

Kodo Rock marks the straight path between Camp Narache and Brambleblade Ravine, where hostile quilboar hold territory. Worn earth circles its base. Its profile recalls the kodo beasts that wander the grasslands, though it is smaller than the bluffs around Red Cloud Mesa. For tribesfolk crossing Mulgore’s windswept plains, the stone offers a quiet landmark.

Among the Shu'halo, natural formations carry spiritual weight. Young tauren shamans beginning their spiritual walk are directed to Kodo Rock for early rites of passage. There, at the solitary stone, novices commune with elemental forces and honor the natural world before they venture into more perilous reaches of the continent.
